Name: Happy Hunting (no clip slingshots and other projectiles) (ranged combat fix)
Author: LilietBorodina
Description:
My first C# mod! Woot!

Ranged combat in vanilla SDV is not really viable, since just about every occasion where you'd really want to use it inevitably has your projectile break against the wall or the edge of the water (???) or a random decorative rock you hadn't even noticed was there. I personally think that's a shame.

And so, now every projectile generated to hurt monsters will ignore terrain collisions. It will only collide with its actual targets or the edge of the map.

Should be compatible with Literally Everything. I personally wanted it for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12369]Sword and Sorcery[/url]'s bow and arrow, and the sky's the limit!



[size=2]The Github repository is [url=https://github.com/LilietB/HappyHunting]here[/url]. Shared under the Creative Commons license. If the mod breaks and I'm gone for more than a couple of months, go ahead and make an update if you want to![/size]
